## Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours delivered a flurry of major sports developments across football, basketball, and badminton. In European football, Liverpool moved swiftly to replace Arne Slot with Andoni Iraola, while Manchester United agreed a £35m deal for Atalanta midfielder Ederson. The CBA Finals produced a historic first buzzer-beater, and the Indonesia Open badminton tournament saw Chinese shuttlers advance. Meanwhile, FIFA unveiled new offside technology for the 2026 World Cup, and F1's Monaco Grand Prix looms with Ferrari tipped as favourites. Here are the key stories:

- **Liverpool appoint Andoni Iraola** – The club reached a verbal agreement with the Bournemouth manager to succeed Arne Slot, marking a significant managerial shift ([Liverpool agree deal with Iraola](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4gv1ydm4yro)).

- **FIFA introduces semi-automated offside tech** – The delayed flag may soon vanish as new tracking technology is approved for the 2026 World Cup ([No more delayed flag? Fifa adds new offside tech for World Cup](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c232d34kkyzo)).
- **CBA Finals history made** – Goodwin's buzzer-beater gave his team a win over Guangsha, the first last-second game-winner in CBA Finals history ([古德温压哨绝杀广厦](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBreHVjdjRxUld3QzV4anhjLXZueWtIbWhKcGszYUY5SkZVak54clNVUjExTFZTdXlXUUVvRXZJX1d4andXUGdHMXQyazdSaFhGZUhFYXRZUmo3alVSOVJNeHZ5QUgxLVpMX3BiN2FwUmRJdEdfQjhr)).

- **F1: Ferrari tipped for Monaco glory** – Rivals see Ferrari as favourites for the Monaco GP, with Hamilton and Leclerc both eyeing victory ([Can Hamilton beat Leclerc if Ferrari live up to Monaco 'favourites' tag?](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13549132/why-ferrari-are-being-tipped-as-monaco-grand-prix-favourites-by-f1-rivals-as-lewis-hamilton-charles-leclerc-eye-glory)).
- **Tennis: Kostyuk dedicates win to Ukraine** – Marta Kostyuk beat compatriot Svitolina to reach the French Open semi-finals, the first Ukrainian woman to do so ([I want to give this match to Ukraine](https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/articles/clypkqpe3d2o)).

**Watch next:** The Monaco Grand Prix (June 7) will test Ferrari's early-season dominance, while the CBA Finals continue and the Indonesia Open badminton tournament reaches its knockout stages. Football transfer activity is expected to accelerate ahead of the summer window.
